Four immediate Ctrl/action-default/reset wrappers with selection and command-time zero-carry guards.

runtime_acceptance: Under a verified future T53 runtime, reconstruct each 640-657 episode and compare the same actor's exact order-706 rate before and after the retask. Accept only if the flood materially falls or disappears while the requested assignment persists, later recurrence is classified, and all preserved worker/transport/garrison behaviors remain healthy.
rollback: Revert 5ece337 independently if actor-level 706 telemetry is unchanged/worse, the Ctrl assignment does not persist, resources are lost, or any protected behavior regresses; retain e359ea5 diagnostics for attribution.
stopping_conditions: Every sampled retask is correlated to the exact actor's pre/post/later 706 stream.
Unsampled major 706 actors are reported rather than attributed by inference.

villager.order706 remains INVESTIGATING until the cause itself is established.
